reassessment_reason: The September HOLD predates the implemented offline parser and standalone application operation. Current public documentation still supports its structural contract; a new connector is unnecessary. This review establishes no retained publisher package or production admission.

access.bulk: Monthly complete tilde-delimited database with 19 relational record types; weekly files contain the corresponding week's filings using the same structure.
access.api: No supported credentialless acquisition API was established.
access.search: Custom XHTML reports are a separate paid product filtered by entity type, registration period or ZIP prefix.
access.fees: Master $500; weekly update $150; custom report $1 per 40 records.

fields.summary: Published layout includes 10-character Filing Number, Status ID, Corp Type ID, Address ID, dates, type-02 addresses, type-11/type-12 lookup labels, and a type-99 trailer with process date and 18 type counts. Existing parser validates widths, joins and trailer counts.

active_status_semantics: Status descriptions are source-native legal filing facts. No approved mapping to currently operating establishments or identifier lifecycle guarantee was established.
statewide_completeness: Advertised complete registry database is not a census of physical operating businesses. No current control total or source release was acquired.
address_zip: Type-02 publishes Zip Code and Zip Extension independently. The local parser retains administrative addresses and ZIP5/ZIP4 separately; these are not verified physical sites.
automation_terms_fees: Paid download route and public schema do not specify unattended transfer permission, retry limits or current-version guarantees.
redistribution: Official disclaimer allows agency sharing of public filings subject to redactions and warns about accuracy/timeliness. It does not settle commercial bulk derivative rights. Existing minimized outputs remain local-review-only.
temporal_refresh: Monthly and weekly product frequencies are published; deletion, correction, replay and source checksum guarantees remain unresolved.

citations.evidence: HTTP 200 public product and pricing documentation; no order or sample requested.
HTTP 200 schema-only layout and trailer fields.
HTTP 200 agency public-record sharing, personal-data redaction and accuracy notice.

strongest_next_action: Reuse the existing offline/app implementation. Before any paid acquisition, resolve current schema continuity, Filing Number lifecycle, weekly replay semantics, status/address meaning, transfer permission and derived-use rights. No contact, purchase, download, account, terms acceptance or production action is authorized by this evidence.
